# Iheb Hamdi

> Iheb Hamdi is a full-stack software engineer based in Barcelona, Spain. He ships production web systems end to end — REST APIs, relational data models and React front ends — and builds LLM-powered features. He works in Agile/Scrum teams with Git-based code review and CI/CD.

- Website: https://portfolio-khaki-chi.vercel.app/
- GitHub: https://github.com/hamdiheb
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/hamdiheb
- Location: Barcelona, Catalonia, Spain
- Role: Full-Stack Software Engineer (React, Node.js, Express, PostgreSQL)
- Languages spoken: Arabic (native), English (C1), French (B1–B2), Spanish (B1), Catalan (A2)
- Contact: use the contact form on the website or LinkedIn

## Skills

- Languages: JavaScript (ES6+), TypeScript, SQL, HTML5, CSS3

- Backend: Node.js, Express 4/5, REST API design, WebSockets, JWT/session/cookie authentication, caching, rate limiting, CORS, input validation

## Projects

- [Shift Tech Innovation](https://www.shifttechinnovation.com/) (freelance, September–October 2026): marketing website for an AI-process-driven cloud architecture firm and authorized Google Solutions Reseller (Gemini Enterprise, Google Workspace, Google Cloud, Chrome Enterprise, cybersecurity, education). Fully translated into English, Spanish and Portuguese, with the language auto-detected from the visitor's time zone (no network call or permission prompt); two-step consultation form that hands off to WhatsApp with a pre-filled message; animated hero and lazy-rendered sections. Stack: React, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Motion.
- [Jobby](https://jobby-lac-chi.vercel.app/) (solo, 2026): six remote job boards in one tab — searches RemoteOK, Arbeitnow, Remotive, Jobicy, We Work Remotely and Adzuna at once, tracks your applications and maps employers near you. PostgreSQL with hand-written SQL (no ORM); authentication built from scratch (bcrypt passwords, hashed session tokens, CSRF protection, rate limiting); Cloudflare R2 direct uploads with presigned S3 URLs; backend and database in Docker on Google Cloud, front end on Vercel; an AI agent, running a model through the OpenRouter gateway, that searches for companies near the user, with its answers checked and its costs capped.
- [AB Auto Centre](https://www.abautocentre.com/) (freelance, August 2026): booking and showcase site for a Québec auto repair shop, integrated two-way with the garage's GEM-CAR management system — live availability computed from shop hours minus GEM occupancy, confirmed bookings written back as client, vehicle, appointment and work order. Resilient caching around a rate-limited third-party API, timezone-correct availability engine, Postgres Row-Level Security. Stack: React 19, Express 5, Supabase/Postgres, Vercel, Render.
- [PikPilot](https://pikpilot.netlify.app) (solo, 2026): AI-powered movie discovery platform that turns plain-language requests into film recommendations, pairing an LLM with the TMDB API so every result is verified against real data. 5-endpoint Express REST API with per-IP rate limiting, strict CORS and input validation. Stack: React 19, Vite, Express 5, Tailwind CSS, GSAP, OpenRouter, TMDB API, Netlify, Render. Source: https://github.com/hamdiheb/PIKPILOT
- [GuessWho](https://guesswhomigracode.netlify.app) (3-person team, 2026): full-stack multiplayer social game with an AI question generator on the OpenRouter API; he designed core gameplay logic, led the visual redesign and authored 52 of 106 commits across 28 merged pull requests. Stack: React 19, Express 5, PostgreSQL (Supabase), OpenRouter, Netlify, Render. Source: https://github.com/hamdiheb/GuessWhoProject
- This portfolio: React 19 + TypeScript + Vite + Tailwind CSS front end, with a CV chatbot backed by a LangChain retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) API.
